column2: Ghost Redirect yaml broke my site
column13:
RohitLakh (2023-07-30T10:11:52Z): @mikejones3 The regex that you are using for `/` will match for any url. 
URL home/ -> home/home/ -> home/home/home/ till infinite until the server stops redirecting. 

You can use regex here to implement the base route that you want to update

This would work just fine for you.

```
301:
  ^\/$: /home/
```

This will only match `/`, nothing before and nothing after | mikejones3 (2023-07-30T15:28:12Z): thanks! | ErisDS (2023-07-31T18:32:37Z): Hi @mikejones3, Ghost has worked as expected here. As @RohitLakh has explained, the redirect you have setup will match any path.

You've also setup your redirect to point to `/home` without a trailing slash, but Ghost always redirects to the version with a trailing slash, probably adding to the pain here.

I think you already found a similar reply from me [on the forum](https://forum.ghost.org/t/undoing-a-redirect-loop/26795/4) but a 301 redirect is a permanent redirect and will be heavily cached, so it's expected that uploading a new file alone won't fix the broken redirect.
